item.title: Arvell Reese, Sonny Styles & David Bailey are BUILT DIFFERENT! | NFL Combine Day 1 Recap
item.description: The guys breakdown the first explosive night at the 2026 NFL Combine. They marvel at the Ohio State takeover by Arvell Reese and Sonny Styles. Then, is the pure "linebacker" position a dying idea in the evolution of modern NFL defense? Next, how possible it is that 2 LBs could be taken in the top 5!? Plus, they converse over David Bailey and how he flew in the 40 and up peoples boards. Finally, did Rueben Bain Jr.'s arm length raise a red-flag that NFL GMs can't unsee? Hosts: Logan Paulsen, Jaso
